author: Carlos Martinez
title: iRacing at Okayama: MX-5 and Porsche Clips
description: Short iRacing clips from Okayama International Circuit in Japan, with Mazda MX-5 race action and laps from a Porsche cockpit.

sections.p: This is iRacing, a racing simulator. It is not real life. These clips are all from the sim.
I recorded a group of short clips at Okayama International Circuit. Some are Mazda MX-5 races. Some are laps from a Porsche cockpit.

list: A race start in the MX-5s. The lights go from red to green with a yellow MX-5 on the front, and a blue car spins in smoke on the right.
Door to door in an MX-5. A red MX-5 is ahead, and another MX-5 in Mazda livery runs right alongside.
Three white and blue MX-5s nose to tail through a corner and over the kerbs, seen from the replay camera.
A full field of MX-5s bunched up after the start, then a white MX-5 and a blue MX-5 side by side.
A lap from a Porsche cockpit past the wooded hills and the Lexus banner, with a car ahead on the straight.
A replay of a green Porsche GT3 car going through a corner, after a lap past the Autobacs banners and the grandstand.
Quiet laps from the Porsche cockpit past the tyre walls, the Pirelli and Autobacs banners and the wooded hills.

sections.p: Okayama International Circuit is in Japan. One lap is 3.703 km. It hosted the Formula 1 Pacific Grand Prix in 1994 and 1995. More sim racing guides are on the blog.

faqs.q: Is this real racing or iRacing?
faqs.a: It is iRacing, a racing simulator. It is not real life.

faqs.q: Which cars are in these clips?
faqs.a: The race clips show Mazda MX-5 cars. The lap clips are filmed from a Porsche cockpit, and one replay follows a green Porsche GT3 car.

faqs.q: How long is the Okayama track?
faqs.a: Okayama International Circuit is in Japan, and one lap is 3.703 km. It hosted the Formula 1 Pacific Grand Prix in 1994 and 1995.
